messages:
tara: Heads up team 1: planning a compact EU-focused telemetry demo with Datadog for next Thurs 09:30 CET. Goal: show telem + privacy controls + an airgapped path. Mike, can you own infra + collector? :calendar:
mike: Yup. I'll provision an EU sandbox cluster and validate collector configs. Need KMS details and whether we choose agentless OTLP or proxy.

chloe: I'll build the demo dashboard. Want to include latency SLOs, per-model token-cost estimates, and a privacy overlay that explains redaction.

sven_dd: Datadog will host a localized tile in eu.datadoghq. We need traces via Datadogs EU trace endpoint and a compact integration doc for the tile.

jaime_security: For GDPR/PII constraints: specify redaction rules, retention window, and KMS key rotation cadence. Add a simple dataflow diagram to the runbook.

oliver_si: SI team can prepare an offline collector bundle and an install script for customers who require airgap installs.

mike: Draft OTLP config (collector) below 1 - will test this in sandbox later today:

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: {}
processors:
  batch:
  attributes:
    actions:
      - key: "prompt_text"
        action: delete
      - key: "user_input"
        action: delete
exporters:
  datadog:
    endpoint: "https://trace.datadoghq.eu"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [attributes,batch]
      exporters: [datadog]
```

mike: Use ENV var DATADOG_API_KEY from our secrets manager; no hardcoded keys. We'll also hash user IDs before export.

tara: Action items: mike (sandbox + manifests), chloe (dashboards + demo flows), jaime_security (data handling + retention), oliver_si (airgap bundle), sven_dd (tile + test creds). I'll draft the runbook and invite attendees.

chloe: Dashboard will surface: 1) per-tenant trace sampler, 2) model latency heatmap, 3) token_cost counter, 4) fallback-route traces when we hit Dedicated capacity. Also add a privacy panel that lists redacted attributes.

sven_dd: We'll supply tile assets and a short integration guide. We can also provide a temporary read-only test API key scoped to the demo environment.

jaime_security: Proposed default retention: 90 days for EU traces, with an option to reduce to 30 days for sensitive customers. Confirmed: redact prompt_text, user_input, and email fields before export.

mike: I'll push a helm values.yaml and kube manifest to the sandbox repo by 18:00 CET. ETA for collector smoke test: this afternoon.

oliver_si: For airgap: building tarball of collector binary + start script + manifest. Will include secure checksum + transfer checklist.

tara: Reminder 1 we must not send raw prompt text off-cluster. Chloe & Mike, confirm redaction pipeline removes prompts and only sends aggregated/token-level metrics + span metadata.

chloe: Confirmed. Span processor will delete prompt_text and user_input attributes, emit token_count, model_name, latency_ms, error_flag.

mike: Confirmed. Collector attribute processor will delete/pseudonymize sensitive fields and hash user_id attributes.

sven_dd: We'll note this in the tile docs and add a short privacy blurb on the demo page.

tara: Great. I'll assemble the runbook stub and share a link. @sven_dd please DM demo creds when ready.

dd-demo-bot: Demo creds created (read-only), expires in 72h: demo-eu-2026-xyz789 1 DM sent.

tara: Thanks all. If anything blocks, ping here; otherwise reconvene tomorrow for a final dry-run. :white_check_mark:
